description: Reproducible EPA SWMM model package for LID/SUDS-based urban pluvial flood mitigation in a school area of Durán, Ecuador is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Joao Calle Espinoza (Escuela Superior Politecnica del Litoral). This repository contains a reproducible EPA SWMM modelling package developed to evaluate low-impact development (LID) and sustainable urban drainage system (SuDS) scenarios for mitigating pluvial flooding at a school site in Durán, Ecuador. Coverage: national (EC); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
